abstract: This is a student problem set for a linear algebra course with three problems. Problem 1 asks the student to diagonalize a 2x2 matrix and use the diagonalization to compute its 10th power in closed form. Problem 2 asks for a proof that every real symmetric matrix has an orthonormal eigenbasis. Problem 3 asks for the rank, nullity, and a basis for the column space of a given 4x5 matrix, with all work shown. The excerpt summarized here states only the problem prompts and does not include worked solutions or the specific matrices.
